_meta.coverage_metric: planted hollow-receipt, unsafe merge-rule target, forged/stale merge-admit, canonical-link divergence, and wasteful CI publication detection
_meta.purpose: Prove that delivery receipts, repo-scoped Codex merge rules, merge-authority preflight, canonical linking, and private-Actions publication all fail closed without network access.

covers: complete receipt
missing artifact is failure rather than skip
runnable.expected: good PASS and hollow UNMATERIALIZED FAIL

covers: repository-scoped prefix rule
existing rule backup
unsafe repository rejection
PreToolUse and human-gate boundary warning
runnable.expected: good repo installs and checks allow; hollow target fails before Codex execution

covers: merge-admit label applied by a non-owner is refused
admit that predates the head commit is stale, not valid
nothing admitted exits 3, distinct from a layer refusing with 1
a PreToolUse hook that exits 2 refuses the run on the active host only
runnable.expected: good PREFLIGHT GREEN; hollow blocked at L1; empty exits 3; blocking hook exits 1

runnable.good_fixture: identical copy of the canonical skill in a scratch repo
runnable.hollow_fixture: same copy with a local edit appended to SKILL.md
covers: diverged copy is refused and left untouched, never moved aside
old copy is moved to a backup, never deleted
re-running on an already-linked target is an idempotent success
linking the canonical directory to itself is refused
runnable.expected: good converts and stays readable through the link; hollow exits non-zero naming the divergence

covers: local commit cadence is independent from remote CI publication cadence
exact local HEAD requires a passing local verification receipt
only initial draft PR, ready-for-review, and one batched repair are admitted
older-SHA CI success and repeated feedback fail closed
billing or spending-limit no-runner evidence opens a circuit breaker
only a later owner-authored recovery receipt can admit another attempt
runnable.expected: good initial publication ALLOW; hollow billing snapshot BLOCK; stale HEAD, repeated feedback, and stale recovery remain red
